roster.name: MIRAGE Sample Preparation Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for glycomics sample generation, purification and modification. Specifies metadata to record sample origin (biological or chemical), processing steps (isolation, modification, purification), and defined sample naming to ensure reproducible glycomics datasets.

roster.name: MIRAGE Mass Spectrometric (MS) Analysis Guidelines for Glycans and Glycoproteins (v1.0)
roster.description: MS reporting guideline for glycosciences describing how to report mass-spectrometric analyses of glycans and glycoproteins. Covers required metadata for instrumentation, acquisition, processing and exemplar publications for compliance to enable reproducible MS-based glycomics data.

roster.name: MIRAGE Glycan Microarray Analysis Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for glycan microarray experiments covering metadata to describe array design, glycan probes, assay conditions, detection and data interpretation to standardize and enable comparison of glycan-binding assays.

roster.name: MIRAGE Liquid Chromatography Analysis Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for liquid chromatography analyses in glycomics, specifying metadata about chromatographic conditions, columns, gradients, detection and data processing required for reproducible LC-based glycan analysis.

roster.name: MIRAGE NMR Glycan Recognition Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Guidelines for reporting NMR experiments that probe glycan recognition, detailing experimental conditions, sample preparations, NMR parameters and interpretation needed to document glycan–ligand interaction studies.

roster.name: MIRAGE NMR Glycan Structures Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for determining and reporting glycan structures by NMR, covering sample prep, acquisition parameters, spectral assignment and structural interpretation metadata to support reproducible structural determination.

roster.name: MIRAGE Capillary Electrophoresis Analysis Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for capillary electrophoresis (CE) analyses of glycans, specifying required metadata on CE instruments, separation conditions, detectors and data processing to standardize CE-based glycomics workflows.

roster.name: MIRAGE Lectin Microarray Analysis Guidelines (v1.0)
roster.description: Reporting guideline for lectin microarray experiments in glycomics, describing metadata requirements for array composition, lectin characterization, assay protocol, detection and data analysis for consistent reporting of lectin-binding profiles.
